description: Figure 9, titled "Comprehensive Evaluation Results on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," is a grouped bar chart that compares the performance of four different models across ten distinct datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," lists the evaluation benchmarks from left to right: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled "Score (%)," represents the performance score in percentage, with a scale from 0 to 80 in increments of 10. The chart displays four models, as indicated by the legend: LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue), Ours (SFT baseline) (orange), Ours (DPO baseline) (green), and Ours (iterative RLHF) (red). For each benchmark, the four bars are grouped together, with the "Ours (iterative RLHF)" model (red) generally achieving the highest score, particularly on GSM-8K, MMLU, and HumanEval, where it surpasses 75%. The "LLaMA-3-8B-it" (blue) model consistently performs the second best. The "Ours (DPO baseline)" (green) and "Ours (SFT baseline)" (orange) models show similar performance, which is typically lower than the other two, with the SFT baseline often being the lowest. The chart shows a clear trend of the iterative RLHF model outperforming the others across most benchmarks.
